resources.string: Alerts when estimated noise exceeds 80 dB for 1 second, then waits 1 minute.

2. Place the phone beside a sound level meter.
3. Use a stable, moderate sound.
4. Enter the meter reading below.
5. Tap Calibrate automatically.
Ready to use. Calibration is optional and only improves accuracy.
